name: GAINS Stage I: Shape Estimation
definition: A two-stage inverse rendering optimization pipeline. Stage I optimizes geometry (shape G) using a base re-rendering loss augmented with learning-based priors (depth, normal, diffusion) to prevent overfitting and artifacts under sparse input views.
summary: GAINS Stage I optimizes 2D Gaussian Splatting geometry from sparse images using monocular priors and diffusion model guidance to prevent artifacts.
